text:
ishaan: quick heads-up, brought up a Llama->Mistral converted variant (cassiopeia-lite) and seeing consistent drop on small-codegen bench. top-k choices for numeric literals and dates differ vs upstream. latency unchanged.

mei: any tokenizer diffs? often numerical token boundaries shift with converters that don't preserve specials.

ishaan: ran a token-id diff for a few snippets, saw '=' token move by +1 and digits shift too. converter flags were `--from=llama --to=mistral --shift-ids yes --preserve-specials no`.

ruth: that sounds like the global-offset pattern. combined with rotary/headwise remap at load time it can pick wrong sin/cos entries for KV cache indices and alter decoding.

ops-bot: auto-check: token-id-diff exceeded threshold for top-20 tokens. artifact marked quarantine.

ishaan: quick test: reconvert with `--preserve-specials` and load with headwise-scaling disabled. small eval (n=40) recovered most of the BLEU delta.

mei: also diff the rotary frequency arrays headwise between upstream and converted weights, compute their L2 norm. tiny multipliers (0.9995 vs 1.0) can amplify on longer contexts.

ruth: mitigation: conversion should lock special ids before any global shift and emit a warning if a non-zero offset is applied. loader should refuse headwise-scaling by default for converted artifacts unless explicitly allowed.

triage-bot: filed INFR-418 "converter: enforce preserve-specials and rotary smoke" linking to prior INFR-214.

ishaan: plan: 1) reconvert affected artifacts, 2) change converter default to preserve specials, 3) add conversion-time smoke that diffs token ids for common numerals/punctuation and compares rotary L2 norm, 4) update onboarding checklist.

mei: I'll add the smoke test and a tiny threshold check. ruth: can you update model-catalog to quarantine current artifact until reconversion?

ruth: done, catalog flag set and owners notified.

ishaan: will re-run full bench after PR merges. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
